title: 第576章 新的丹药突破金仙第575章 热血酣战在线炼丹
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
每一块都被五色神火包裹着。
悬浮在乾坤鼎周围。
如同一场精心编排的拆解仪式。
秦无涯和冷月涵一左一右守住两侧。
苏念则在不远处重新布下。
一层简化的隐匿阵法。
以防炼药的动静引来不必要的目光。
上官柔儿抱着小白狐。
坐在一块还算平整的石头上。
默默地替李玄看着周围的风吹草动。
约莫一个时辰后。
乾坤鼎中传出几声清脆的嗡鸣。
李玄掀开鼎盖，七枚通体金红相间。
表面流淌着细微佛光纹路的丹药从鼎中飞出。
稳稳地落入他的掌心。
他看了一眼自己左手掌心那一片焦黑。
咧嘴笑了笑，然后站起身来，将丹药分给众人。
“佛光还没彻底散干净。”
“但药力已经中和得差不多了。”
“青毛狮王这身皮肉骨骼里。”

“积攒了不知道多少年的佛门底蕴。”
“够咱们用一阵子了。”
“回妖界的路上吃了。”
“至少能把刚才那场消耗补回来。”
七人没有多留，各自收好丹药。
沿着来路快速返回妖界外围的防线之内。
一路上没有遇到什么阻碍。
偶尔有几缕零散的阴气从远处飘过。
也被冷月涵毫不客气地一锤子砸散了。
回到妖界提供的临时驻地的当晚。
七人各自闭关，吞下了那枚。
用青毛狮王尸身炼制的丹药。
药力在体内化开的瞬间。
李玄只觉得一股温润而厚重的气息。
顺着他受损的经脉缓缓流淌。
如同温水浸润干裂的河床。
将他掌心那一片焦黑的灼伤。
一点点抚平、修复。
他闭上眼，心神沉入丹田深处。
感受着玄仙巅峰那道壁垒后面的。
content_en:
Each piece is wrapped in five colors of divine fire.
Suspended around the Qiankun Cauldron.
Like a carefully choreographed dismantling ceremony.
Qin Wuya and Leng Yuehan guarded the two sides, one on the left and the other on the right.
Su Nian re-deployed not far away.
A simplified concealment formation.
To prevent the movement of refining medicine from attracting unnecessary attention.
Shangguan Rouer held the little white fox.
Sitting on a fairly flat rock.
Silently watching for Li Xuan's surroundings.
About an hour later.
Several crisp buzzing sounds came from the Qiankun Cauldron.
Li Xuan opened the lid of the cauldron, revealing seven golden and red ones.
The elixir with subtle lines of Buddha's light flowing on its surface flew out of the cauldron.
It fell firmly into his palm.
He glanced at the burnt black palm of his left hand.
He grinned, then stood up and distributed the elixir to everyone.
"The Buddha's light has not been completely dispersed."
"But the drug has almost neutralized it."
"Within the flesh and bones of the Blue-haired Lion King."
"I have accumulated Buddhist heritage for countless years."
"It will last us a while."
"I ate it on the way back to the demon world."
"At least we can make up for the loss just now."
The seven of them didn't stay too long and each collected the elixirs.
Quickly return to the defense line outside the demon world along the way you came.
There were no obstacles along the way.
Occasionally, there are a few scattered strands of Yin Qi drifting from a distance.
They were also smashed to pieces by Leng Yuehan without mercy.
The night I returned to the temporary residence provided by the demon world.
The seven of them went into seclusion and swallowed the one.
An elixir refined from the body of the Green-haired Lion King.
The moment the medicine is released in the body.
Li Xuan only felt a warm and thick breath.
It flowed slowly along his damaged meridians.
Like warm water soaking a dry riverbed.
The black burn on his palm.
Smooth and repair little by little.
He closed his eyes and his mind sank deep into his Dantian.
Feeling what's behind the barrier at the peak of Xuanxian.
